name: epa-drinking-water-mcp-server
description: Search EPA drinking water systems, violations, enforcement actions, and contaminant measurements via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE.title: DataCanvas provider
CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE.description: Optional SQL staging: none or duckdb. DuckDB requires native bindings in the npm runtime.

SDWIS_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.title: Enable dataframe removal
SDWIS_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.description: Set true to enable removal of staged tables when DataCanvas is enabled.

CANVAS_DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT.title: SQL retained-row ceiling
CANVAS_DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT.description: Framework default 10000; the server maximum is 25000 rows.

CANVAS_DEFAULT_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB.title: Canvas memory limit (MiB)
CANVAS_DEFAULT_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB.description: DuckDB memory budget per engine, at most 512 MiB.
